mentions.name: Gatana
mentions.description: An enterprise/organization-focused MCP gateway with sophisticated credentials management, OIDC/SAML integration, team and profile support, external secret stores (AWS/GCP/Azure/HashiCorp Vault), envelope encryption, and an in-band MCP authorization trigger for cases like trying to use a tool that Gatana does not yet have credentials for. Aimed at Agent-to-Agent workloads, dev teams, and GitHub Copilot agents; built on k8s, NodeJS, and React, with Google KMS, hosted on GKE using GKE Sandbox for local server isolation.
